context: Detail stays in Honcho pokoin-cursor + Codevira; Hermes hermes-peer1 is personal/operator only.

decision: Pokoin app runtime secrets (Stripe, DB, Oracle API) belong in pokemon_card_vault/.env.local and server env on peer3 — not in Hermes private/flareon unless explicitly shared for deploy scripts.
context: Do not mix Pokoin production payment/auth secrets into Flareon operator folder.

decision: Production English marketplace autocomplete/searchbar uses Meilisearch for candidate retrieval; Oracle remains the hydration/ranking source and non-English stays on legacy search.
context: Implemented after the split/legacy path produced empty first-character pools and multi-second pika+ latency. Peer3 Docker API reaches Meili through a persistent peer tunnel on the Docker bridge, then pokoin.com proxies /api/* to api.pokoin.com.
